items.headline: ChatGPT release notes add “Try on” and security history
items.summary: O’s ChatGPT release notes (Oct 16, 2026) describe new shopping visual try-on and a “security history” view for recent account activity, aiming to improve user features and account oversight.

items.headline: GPT-6 Sol and Luna October 2026 safety update
items.summary: O’s Deployment Safety Hub posts an October 2026 update for GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, updating preparedness classification for relevant risk domains and reinforcing controlled rollout/safeguards.

items.headline: V announces $251M Series D to scale orbital drug processing
items.summary: V announced a $251M Series D to scale space-based pharmaceutical processing, citing increased launch cadence and the need to scale return logistics and manufacturing capacity for in-orbit therapies.
